C1.原句: An ultrathin Li metal anode (50 µm), a high-loading S cathode of 4.4 mgScm  2, and an E/S ratio of 6.6 µLmgS   1 were selected for practical considerations.

C2.原句: Under mild conditions, Li-S batteries were assembled with Li metal anodes (600 µm), regular-loading S cathodes (1.1 mgS cm-2), and 25 µL electrolyte.

C3.原句: Under demanding conditions, an ultrathin Li anode (50 µm), a high-loading S cathode (4.4 mgS cm-2) or an ultrahigh-loading S cathode (9.9 mgS cm-2), and electrolyte (35 or 90 µL, respectively) were employed to assemble Li-S batteries.

指标.取值点: 0.1C 循环寿命（B 第 65 圈过充）
指标.原句: The cycle life of Li  S battery using HME-EPSE increases to 113 cycles, which is nearly twice that of 65 cycles with DOL/DME electrolyte.
In contrast, at the 69th cycle, the Li  S battery with HME-EPSE maintains a specific capacity of 860 mAhg  1 with 85% capacity retention and a Coulombic efficiency of 95% (Figure S13).

HME-EPSE decreases the shuttle current to 0.055 mAcm  2 when it reaches its peak at 2.35 V, which is reduced by 55% compared with the battery with DOL/DME electrolyte with a peak current of 0.122 mAcm  2 (Figure 3a)
Meanwhile, the Li  S battery using HME-EPSE delivers an initial specific capacity of 856 mAhg  1, which is comparable to that in DOL/DME electrolyte.

指标.取值点: 容量降至初始 60% 的圈数
指标.原句: The cycle life of the battery with HME-EPSE increases to 280 cycles when the capacity decays to 60% of the initial capacity, which is more than twice of DOL/DME electrolyte.
At 0.1 C, the initial specific capacity of the battery with HME-EPSE is 737 mAhg  1, which is lower than that with DOL/DME electrolyte (826 mAhg  1).

However, after 40 cycles, the battery with HME-EPSE maintains a specific capacity of 482 mAhg  1 with 65% capacity retention and has far exceeded the battery with DOL/DME electrolyte which delivers 168 mAhg  1 with only 20% capacity reten- tion (Figure S14).
